Harsh Desai | harsh.desai101@example.com | +91 9575959140
Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra

Professional Summary
Senior Data Engineer with a strong focus on designing and delivering scalable data pipelines, optimizing analytics workflows, and enabling reliable data products. Experienced in cloud-native data architectures, automation, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to drive measurable business outcomes. Open to relocation anywhere in India. Notice period: 30 days.

Technical Skills
Python, SQL, Apache Airflow, dbt, SQS, EC2, S3, Agile, Jira

Work Experience

Senior Data Engineer, Trellis Systems (Jul 2024 - Present)
- Implemented modular analytics pipelines using dbt and SQL to standardize transformation logic across product metrics, improving data consistency for BI reports and reducing query failures by 30% using dbt testing and documentation.
- Built AWS-based ingestion and processing workflows on EC2 and S3 backed by SQS for reliable event-driven data movement; reduced end-to-end data latency for daily aggregates from 6 hours to under 90 minutes.
- Collaborated with product and analytics teams in Agile ceremonies tracked in Jira to prioritize ETL work, and automated Airflow-compatible DAG triggers integrating dbt runs and SQL validation checks.

Big Data Engineer, Ledgerly (May 2019 - Jun 2024)
- Designed and maintained large-scale ETL pipelines orchestrated with Apache Airflow, handling batch and near-real-time processing of financial transaction data and ensuring SLA adherence through alerting and retries.
- Developed Python-based data ingestion services on EC2 that streamed cleaned data to S3 and downstream analytics layers; implemented SQS for decoupled message delivery and improved fault tolerance.
- Introduced SQL-based validation tests and dbt models to codify business logic for reporting; partnered with stakeholders in Agile workflows managed via Jira to deliver periodic data products and dashboards.

Education
CA, ICAI
